title_ru: ЭЛЕМЕНТЫ — ЭЛЕМЕНТЫ ОРБИТЫ И ТРАССЫ СПУТНИКОВ
description: Interactive guide to the six orbital elements: decode real two-line element sets, draw ground tracks and see how Earth's bulge turns every orbit.
og: Six numbers pin down any orbit. Set them with sliders, decode five real two-line element sets from November 2026, draw their ground tracks, see J2 turn the node and the perigee, and check a simple propagator against published SGP4 positions.
brand: ELEMENTS — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
llms: How six numbers (a, e, i, Ω, ω, M) pin down an orbit: Kepler's equation, the three orientation angles, two-line element sets decoded field by field on five embedded real TLEs of 12–14 November 2026 (ISS, Landsat 9, GPS IIF-7, Molniya 3-50, GOES-19), ground tracks and why they step west, J2 nodal and apsidal drift checked against published values, drag, and what 'mean elements' means; the page's propagator is Kepler + secular J2 (not SGP4) with its error against published SGP4 positions shown.

freshness.claim: As of November 2026: ordinary 5-digit catalogue numbers ran out at 69999 on 11 July 2026 and the count continued at 100000; CelesTrak issues no TLEs for 6-digit objects (Space-Track documents Alpha-5 TLEs for them); SATCAT at 101387 on 14 Nov 2026
Five embedded element sets (ISS, Landsat 9, Navstar 71, Molniya 3-50, GOES 19) are dated 12–14 November 2026 and shown as dated examples; all five satellites still catalogued in orbit
GOES-19 is GOES East at 75.2° W (since 7 April 2025)
Landsat 9 orbit: 705 km, 98.2°, 16-day repeat, equatorial crossing 10:12 a.m. ± 5 min
Space-Track: element sets come from the 18th Space Defense Squadron; element set number is a constant 999; Alpha-5 covers 100,000–339,999; analyst objects 80,000–89,999
Ephemeris type is 0 in the public element sets shown; type 4 marks SGP4-XP elements
